steps.en: Install the extension from your browser's store (Chrome/Edge/Brave/Opera/Firefox)
steps.zh: 从浏览器扩展商店装好扩展

steps.en: On an article page, fire reader mode
Picks the article from the DOM, strips ads, modals and navigation, re-renders in your font and width
steps.zh: 挑出正文元素，剥掉广告弹窗导航，按你设定的字体宽度重排

steps.en: If auto-selection grabbed the wrong block, enter selection mode and click the real article
steps.zh: 自动选错了？进选择模式点住真正文

steps.en: Re-renders exactly the element you chose; edit, highlight or delete strays in place
steps.zh: 按你点的元素重排，剩余杂质原地删改

steps.en: Make a site always-readable: add its domain to the auto-run list
steps.zh: 让某站永远自动进入：把域名加进自动列表

value.en: The article, readable your way, in place — one keystroke, no copy-paste into a notes app
value.zh: 一篇按你的方式排好版的干净文章，原地可得——一次按键，不用复制到笔记

sources: README.md ZachSaucier/Just-Read @ main (retrieved 2026-09-28): Installation section (Chrome/Brave/Opera/Edge store links, Firefox Add-ons); 'Use the shortcut CTRL+SHIFT+L' under Auto-selection; 'Use the shortcut CTRL+SHIFT+K then click the part of the page highlighted that you want to read' under User selection mode; 'entering a part of the URL (usually the domain is a good choice) or a regular expression (regex) into the "Auto-run domain list" found on the extension's Options page'
